GRADE 7 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) completely.
   C. Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat).

2. About Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explore the key activities of Bhakti Yog among the four faiths for self-development,
   B. Learners should ignore Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) completely.
   C. Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat).

3. About Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth,
   B. Learners should ignore Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) completely.
   C. Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat).

5. About Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. examine the three selected religious ceremonies performed in the four faiths,
   B. Learners should ignore Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony completely.
   C. Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony.

6. About Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret the significance of the three selected religious ceremonies for social cohesion,
   B. Learners should ignore Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony completely.
   C. Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony.

7. About Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. participate in the religious ceremonies for social cohesion,
   B. Learners should ignore Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony completely.
   C. Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Religious Ceremonies Ceremony ceremony.
